items.title: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Q2FY27: revenue Rs 1,760 cr; EV/battery EBITDA loss Rs 32 cr
items.text: GFL reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 1,760 crore (up 45% YoY) and PAT of Rs 240 crore (up 42%). Its battery-materials arm (GFCL EV) posted an EBITDA loss of Rs 32 crore and a PAT loss of Rs 50 crore. Per the investor-slide summary, LiPF6 is ramping with supply to five global electrolyte players, larger LFP capacity is targeted for Q3 FY28, and FY27 capex is Rs 2,300 crore (Rs 1,500 crore for EV/battery materials). Domestic electrolyte demand is expected to pick up only toward the end of next financial year, so local cell-material revenue stays small for now.

items.title: Graphite India board approves Q2 FY27 results; standalone profit Rs 128 cr
items.text: Graphite India's board approved Q2 FY27 results on 3 Nov 2026. The source gives consolidated net profit of Rs 94 crore for the quarter and Rs 265 crore for the half year; the Rs 128 crore headline figure is standalone. The article carried no update on the company's synthetic graphite anode plans, so the battery-anode timeline is unchanged.

items.title: Amara Raja Q2 FY27 profit falls 44.8%; board approves Rs 2,320 cr ARACT capex incl. LFP cell plant
items.text: Amara Raja reported Q2 FY27 net profit down 44.8% to Rs 152.48 crore on revenue up 18.5% to Rs 4,108.71 crore. The board approved Rs 2,320 crore for subsidiary Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies, raising pack capacity from 4 GWh to 9 GWh and building an LFP cell plant at the Giga Corridor in Telangana over 30 months, funded by debt and equity. A domestic cell maker advancing LFP capacity adds to future demand for locally made separator, anode and electrolyte materials.

items.title: PLI stationary-storage cell tender bids pushed to 10 Nov; ALMM-style battery component list mooted
items.text: An ESS News opinion piece by InfoLink Consulting's Robin Song says the tender for the remaining 10 GWh of PLI cell capacity, reserved for grid-scale storage, has had its bid deadline extended from 13 October to 10 November 2026. It says no more than 3 GWh of the 50 GWh ACC-PLI target was operating as of mid-2026, and that the Ministry of Heavy Industries is considering ALMM-style certification for battery components. The roughly INR 130 billion component scheme (cathode, anode, electrolyte, separator, copper foil) still awaits Expenditure Finance Committee review. Slow domestic cell build-out and the lack of an approved materials incentive keep demand for local materials uncertain. This is an opinion piece, not an official notification.

items.title: Himadri Q2 FY27: revenue Rs 1,691 cr; LFP cathode phase 1 deferred to FY28 end
items.text: Himadri reported consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 1,691 crore (+57.93% YoY) and PAT of Rs 231 crore (+31.33%), with EBITDA/tonne of Rs 21,000. The 2,000 MTPA LFP cathode demonstration plant is due in Q3 FY27, but the 40,000 MTPA Phase 1 is now deferred to FY28 end; the 200 MTPA synthetic graphite anode plant has been running since April 2026. FY27 capex is guided at Rs 800-900 crore, funded by internal accruals. The article says the stock fell 8.3% after hours and settled down 3.01% (currency unverified). The cathode delay shows timeline risk for domestic cell-material localisation.

items.title: Cell imports up 94% to Rs 15,721 cr in Q1 FY27 as govt plans Rs 12,000 cr components PLI
items.text: Business Today reports, citing commerce ministry data, that cell imports rose 94% YoY to Rs 15,721 crore in Q1 FY27 and 159% in July 2026 to Rs 7,209 crore. No cell maker has yet received incentives under the Rs 18,100 crore ACC PLI; Ola has 2.5 GWh operating against 20 GWh awarded. The government plans a new Rs 12,000 crore PLI for cathode, anode, electrolyte and copper-foil separator materials. Amara Raja plans Rs 9,500 crore for 16 GWh by 2030-31 after its Gotion tie-up stalled. The scheme is still a plan, not approved.

items.title: SMM: India BESS assembly outpaces cells; over 80% of cells still imported
items.text: SMM's analysis says 23.15 GWh/year of publicly disclosed BESS manufacturing and assembly capacity has been commissioned in India. It cites Tata Power as saying India imports more than 80% of its battery cells. SMM says battery container prices rose about 21.8% from Q4 2025 to September 2026, from around $57/kWh to $69.4/kWh, so imported cell prices still drive cost. This supports the case for localising cells and upstream materials such as separators, anodes and electrolytes.
